rv.q: It is “thrilling” for Debra Craine with “visceral movement” that “evokes youthful rebellion and the passion of first love”.

The Color Of My Voice is a lovely piece of theatre and clearly a love letter to one of the great performers of their time but if I am to judge this by the West End ticket price, it needs a few more bells and whistles to make it more colourful.

cn.t: Campbell's Nina Simone tribute receives mixed reviews, with critics divided on whether the one-woman show successfully captures the icon's complexity and power through its blend of biography and live musical performance.
